 Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Prity Kumari Wife of Rahul Kumar Singh D/O Rajindra Singh, A/P residing  in Parental House situated in Village and P.O.- Akhleshpur, Distt.- Bha  (Kaimur) Pin - 821101  ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Chandra Mohan Jha  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Rajeev Nayan (App 231)
 Mr. Rajbansh Dubey  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 4 21-07-2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Section 323,
498A and some other ancillary Sections of the Indian Penal Code.
3. it is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that dispute between the parties has been resolved through the process of mediation.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the O.P. No.2 does not dispute the contention.

5. In that view of the matter, let the petitioner, above named, in the event of his arrest/ surrender within a period of six weeks from today shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.39679 of 2022(4) dt.21-07-2023 bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-I,
